rationale: The portfolio already holds an open short position in XYL representing 7.4% of buying power, which aligns with the sizing of all other positions in the book. While the instrument shows persistent downward pressure below its 9-EMA and session VWAP on 5.9x relative volume, adding to the short at 3.1% of the daily range would create undue single-name concentration and unfavorable risk-reward near the session lows. Going long is rejected due to the lack of any reversal structure against strong bearish momentum.
